parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The keyword for searching versions. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to retrieve in a single request.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token for the next page. A value of null indicates that no more pages are available.

parameters.name: usage
parameters.description: The usage. Set to Explorer to retrieve meta information.
